method: Purposive sample of 10 distinct requisitions per role family. Employer-hosted pages were opened and descriptions/application links read. Availability means page/application visible, not recruiter confirmation. Not a representative labor-market survey. Tags mean explicit mention, including preferred skills and duties, not always a mandatory requirement. Repeated employer requisitions are distinct business segments, not location clones. No claim these titles originated in the past year.

families.name: Applied AI Engineer
families.interpretation: Production software plus systematic evaluation is the shared core. Python appears in nine descriptions, but ContactMonkey demonstrates that existing Ruby/Vue infrastructure can matter more. Titles cover both product engineering and customer-facing advisory/implementation. These are mostly experienced roles; CHAOS explicitly welcomes exceptional new graduates despite a 2–5-year guideline.

families.name: AI Solutions Architect
families.interpretation: Architecture is hands-on but varies: security presales, post-sales deployment, internal transformation, graph AI, marketing automation and infrastructure advisory. Python appears in nine descriptions but sometimes only preferred; cloud appears in eight. Do not treat these as ten identical jobs or count each city as another posting. HiddenLayer contributes three distinct functional requisitions, making this sample security-heavy.
